query: How does the CFS scheduler pick the next task to run based on virtual runtime?

matches.reason: Core EEVDF algorithm: walks the augmented rb-tree keyed on vruntime/deadline to select the eligible entity (owed service based on vruntime) with the earliest virtual deadline.
Wrapper that invokes pick_eevdf() to choose the scheduling entity and handles delayed dequeue before returning it as the next entity.
Top-level CFS scheduling-class hook (fair_sched_class.pick_task) that updates the current runtime and calls pick_next_entity to obtain the actual next task to run.
Returns the leftmost (smallest vruntime/deadline) entity in the CFS runqueue's rb-tree, used as the starting candidate in pick_eevdf.
